note: Dollars per million tokens, and dollars per billable search or request. The single place to correct when a provider changes price. Read by src/unprompted/cost.py and lib/cost.ts, so the terminal and the dashboard can never disagree about what a week cost. Past runs were billed at the rates of their own week; correcting a rate here restates history, which is why the verified date is recorded.
batch_discount_note: The weekly extraction pass goes through the Batch API at half list price. A multiplier rather than a second rate, because a re-read of a handful of answers still goes out as live calls and is billed in full.

_extract.prices: the extraction pass, billed as ordinary Anthropic tokens
